title: Mine Island2 — independent rules and mathematics
authorship: This implementation and its probabilities are independently authored. The catalog name and one observed 1.10× demo collection are reference observations. This implementation does not reproduce or claim SmartSoft's source code, complete mechanics, RNG, or certified mathematics.
implementedMechanics: Automatic collection at the final successful island
roundRules: Play debits the stake once and attempts the first island.
The first island can fail. A successful first Easy island pays 1.10× if collected.
Each later Jump attempts the next multiplier in the selected ladder.
After any successful attempt, Collect credits the total payout including the original stake and ends the round.
A failed attempt ends the round with zero payout, including previously available uncollected winnings.
The tenth successful attempt collects automatically.
Visual island choices do not influence probabilities or payouts.
The mode cannot change during an active round.

probabilityModel.proof: Multiplying the first and later conditional probabilities cancels all intermediate multipliers. At collect step k, survival probability is 9600/Mk and payout is bet×Mk/10000, so expected payout is bet×9600/10000 = 0.96×bet.
probabilityModel.expectedReturn: 96% for permitted stakes and listed collect steps; this is a theoretical long-run expectation, not a guarantee for any round.
probabilityModel.randomness: Server-only cryptographic bounded integer draws. Each step's survival is independent; outcomes are not calculated from a client-supplied payout.

rounding: The server computes floor(betMinor×multiplierBps/10000) using integer arithmetic. Every v1 permitted stake and multiplier divides exactly, so v1 adds no rounding loss to the calculated 96% expectation.
disclosure: The 96% figure describes this independent engine only. Boost and Portal are absent; the original provider's full game behavior and certified return are not claimed.
